text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide has a severe injury,<n>so I cancel
practice and go visit her to<n>drop some things off.

text_block_list.name: Infirmary Doctor
text_block_list.text:
Hello! If you're looking for Hayahide,<n>she left for
the gym a little while ago.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... I didn't think... this injurywould... affect me so much...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I know. I'm sorry, but please, don't<n>worry.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I suffered a major injury as a child,<n>so I know
what a setback it can be.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
That's why I don't want to waste<n>any time. I want
to continue refining<n>my equations instead.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll pay close attention to my injury<n>while still
carrying out my calculations,<n>so please...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Please don't stop me from<n>progressing!
choice_data_list: We need to go back to the infirmary.

If you're so intent on doing this... then we'll do it
together!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
...I see. So I have no choice but to<n>stand still as
everyone sprints on<n>ahead again...
choice_data_list: If your injury gets worse, you'll never catch up to them.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: You're right. I know that...<n>Intellectually, anyway.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know I can't make the same<n>mistake I did in the
past. But...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, never mind. I'll do as you say.

Biwa Hayahide struggles mightily<n>with her fears of
falling behind, but<n>agrees to rest and recuperate.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Thank you... Thank you for<n>understanding. Let's get
started!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ah!
Thud!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I-I'm fine... I just... I just tripped.

Biwa Hayahide is so overwrought by<n>her first
injury that she ends up<n>giving herself another. It'll
take even<n>longer for her to heal now...

After that, I start working with her on<n>testing out her
calculations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I see... According to this heart rate...<n>the amount of
muscular exertion<n>decreased, just as I predicted.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew... Well, that was productive. Ieven learned about things unrelatedto my calculations.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I realized that I have other<n>advantages besides my
analytical<n>skills. I have someone beside me,<n>willing
to go over theories and<n>calculations together, all for
the sake<n>of improvement.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What I'm saying is... that you're<n>incredibly
important to me. I can't<n>wait to start training again.
